description: This file contains implementation of a generic storage class 'TableExampleStorage' with lifecycle participation, a factory class 'TableExampleStorageFactory' for creating storage instances, and an extension method 'UseTableExampleStorage' for configuring storage services within an Orleans silo builder.

classes.name: TableExampleStorage
classes.description: A generic storage class implementing storage and lifecycle participation for Orleans grains.

classes.description: A factory class for creating instances of TableExampleStorage with proper configuration and lifecycle participation.

classes.description: A static class providing extension methods to configure storage services in Orleans silo builder.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes the storage to the grain lifecycle for state setup.

methods.name: Configure
